subject: SGX — on‑prem attestation & qualification readout
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Bose <anika.bose@sgxhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <thsu@sgxhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: SGX — on‑prem attestation & qualification readout

Hi Anika / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — good call. Quick written summary so we have the same set of asks and owners from the discovery call: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Data residency: PHI must remain in SGX datacenter region and never leave the VPC.
- Regulatory: auditor requires evidence of network controls and attestations for air‑gapped operations.
- Key management: customer‑managed keys (HSM or cloud KMS with HSM backing) are mandatory.
- Egress policy: static outbound IPs for allowlisting, no outbound DNS to the public internet for inference calls.
- Maintenance windows: quarterly change freezes for clinical go‑live windows; require planned patch timeline.

What Redwood can do (high level)
- Private deployment (on‑prem package) that runs inside your VPC with no internet egress by default.
- Support for BYO HSM / KMS and key separation for model artifacts and logs.
- Offline update bundles for air‑gapped environments; we can coordinate package signing and verification.
- Network options: private endpoints (VPC peering / PrivateLink equivalent), and explicit egress IP ranges for allowlist.

Action items & owners
1) SGX: share network inventory (firewall rules, NAT/GW config, proxy behavior) — owner: Anika / Michael — target: 2026‑11‑15.
2) SGX: confirm required cert rotation windows and any FIPS/HSM vendor constraints — owner: Tom — target: 2026‑11‑18.
3) Redwood: send SOC2 artifact subset, sample attestation language, and on‑prem admin guide — owner: Kimberly / Karthik — target: 2026‑11‑09.
4) Schedule technical deep‑dive with SGX infra (1 hour) — proposed week of 2026‑11‑22.

Attachments: attached network diagram we sketched on the call and the SOC2 questionnaire answers for your compliance team.

Please confirm owners/timelines above or propose adjustments. If you want the deep‑dive earlier, we can make room this week but would need the inventory beforehand.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Kimberly — thanks for the clean recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

1) Network contact: looping in Michael Lee (infra lead) on this thread; he will own the inventory and firewall rules.
2) HSM requirement: SGX requires hardware HSM for key custody (we use Thales at the moment). We are open to Redwood integrating with customer HSM through an HSM proxy or KMIP.
3) Egress: we will provide an allowlist of egress IPs; goal is to have deny‑by‑default and explicit only to Redwood endpoints.
4) Timeline: procurement goal remains end of December — meeting that will align with our GRC review.

One question: can Redwood support a maintenance blackout of 7 days per quarter during which only emergency patches are allowed?

I attached our initial network inventory sheet (very rough) — Michael will complete the details by Monday.

Thanks,
Anika Bose
Director, IT Security | SGX Health
anika.bose@sgxhealth.com

Hi Anika / Tom — appreciate the quick follow. A few technical clarifications and what we'll bring to the technical deep‑dive: 

- BYO HSM: we support KMIP and cloud HSM integrations. For Thales, we'll validate an HSM proxy approach during the deep‑dive; we can also support split‑key workflows.
- Offline bundles: our on‑prem package can be delivered as signed update bundles; validation is local and does not require outbound network access.
- DNS & Proxy: we can support explicit internal DNS records and work with a no‑public‑DNS configuration; if you use an outbound proxy we will need proxy credentials and a host allowlist.
- Audit & logs: we can ship audit logs to a customer‑managed syslog endpoint inside the VPC.

Next technical deliverables (Redwood)
- redwood_onprem_admin_guide.pdf (attached) — high‑level install and ops checklist.
- Short runbook for offline update process and bundle verification.

Please share Michael's completed inventory and a sample firewall rule set. Once we have that we can draft the network ACLs and provide the exact egress IP ranges and ports. Proposing a 60‑minute deep‑dive w/ infra, network, and security (Redwood: Karthik + 1 eng) — suggested slots: 2026‑11‑23 9–11am PT or 2026‑11‑24 1–3pm PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
